concerns.text: FR-002 and Edge Cases require the system to 'exclude the window' if tracking fails >20%. Task T063 only raises a warning and flags the bin. No task exists to implement the actual data exclusion logic or re-calculation required to prevent biased averages.

FR-002 requires computing E_vib. Task T018b mandates a specific physics paper citation for the E_vib formula before T018 can run. If no such paper exists (as hinted by the 'Assumptions' section regarding missing metrics), T018 is blocked. A task to define E_vib via first principles or alternative derivation if the citation fails is missing.

US-1 Independent Test requires verifying energy calculations against manual calculations on a synthetic dataset. While T012 tests formulas, no task explicitly covers the generation of the specific synthetic test dataset with known ground-truth values and the execution of the end-to-end verification against manual calculation as described in the US-1 Independent Test.

The spec 'Assumptions' section states the project assumes datasets are available and sufficient. Tasks T060-T063 implement a complex automated data source resolution and fallback system not requested by the spec. While not strictly 'missing' coverage, the lack of a task to *remove* or *simplify* this scope creep suggests the plan is implementing unrequested features, potentially leaving the core spec requirements under-resourced or the plan bloated.

Task T018b cites 'P. E. Kollmann, et al. (2019) Granular Physics' as an example. This appears to be a placeholder or hallucinated citation. The task should be updated to require a verified, real citation or a fallback mechanism, rather than relying on a potentially non-existent paper.
